title: "Freetz-EVO support / general"
body: |
  Welcome to the Freetz-EVO discussions!

  Use this space for general questions, help with flashing/building,
  configuration and everything that is not a concrete bug report or a feature
  request.

  To get the most useful answers, please provide:

  - **Device model**: e.g. FRITZ!Box 7590 AX, 7530, ...
  - **Firmware series**: e.g. 08_2X (as shown by `make menuconfig` or on the
    Freetz web interface)
  - **Build configuration**: attach your `.config` when the question is about
    building (rename it to `config.txt` if GitHub refuses the file type)
  - **What you already tried**: steps performed so far and their outcome
  - **Logs**: format them by wrapping in triple backticks

  ```text
  paste log output here
  ```

  Useful references:

  - [Documentation](https://ircama.github.io/freetz-evo/)
  - [Issues](https://github.com/Ircama/freetz-evo/issues)
  - [Repository](https://github.com/Ircama/freetz-evo)

  > **Notice:** issues in the *Issues* tracker are reserved for bugs and
  > feature requests. Questions posted there will be redirected here.
labels: [support, question]
